title: Global Wind Lounge Seating — Single, 2-Seat and 3-Seat
body_html:
Slim proportions, an open silhouette, and a tuxedo-clean line — Wind makes even a tight reception feel calm and considered.

The Wind series pairs refined geometry with a slender footprint, so single chairs and two- or three-seat sofas can anchor a lobby without crowding it. Steel legs come standard in chrome or brushed chrome, with optional wood legs for added warmth, and every model upholsters in the full range of Global fabric, vinyl or leather. Matching Wind lounge tables with laminate tops in square or round shapes complete the grouping.

Key features

  • Slim, contemporary tuxedo-style profile that keeps sightlines open even in tight footprints
  • Available as single lounge chair, two-seat sofa and three-seat sofa for flexible reception layouts
  • Standard chrome or brushed chrome steel legs, with optional wood legs for added warmth
  • Upholstered in fabric, vinyl or leather across the full range of Global textiles
  • Coordinating Wind lounge tables with laminate tops in square or round configurations
  • Healthcare-compliant models available within the series

Who it’s for

Reception areas, lobbies and open lounge zones in healthcare, education and municipal environments where floor space is limited but a polished, welcoming look matters.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
